req.title: Player deletion persists to DB
req.statement: The system shall remove the row from the players table so GET returns 404 afterwards.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that deleting a player must remove the row from the players table so that a subsequent GET returns 404. The delete endpoint is DELETE /players/squadnumber/{squad_number} (returns 204 on success). The GET-by-UUID endpoint is GET /players/{player_id} (returns 404 if not found). Tests cover: (1) positive EP/STC — delete an existing player and verify 204 then 404 on GET; (2) negative NEG — delete a non-existent squad number returns 404; (3) boundary BVA — delete the lowest squad number (1) and highest (26) to catch off-by-one mutations; (4) STC state-transition — delete then re-create verifies the row is truly gone and can be re-inserted; (5) DT decision-table — double-delete returns 404 on second attempt confirming idempotent absence. The source shows the delete endpoint uses squad_number as path param and the GET-by-id uses UUID, so we first POST to get the UUID or use pre-loaded data UUIDs directly.

tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_delete_existing_player_returns_204_and_get_returns_404():
    del_resp = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/10')
    assert del_resp.status_code == 204
    assert del_resp.content == b''
    get_resp = client.get('/players/e51a3744-b879-41cb-a100-533f9d5a0bc6')
    assert get_resp.status_code == 404

test_delete_existing_player_returns_204_and_get_returns_404()

tests.name: test_delete_then_recreate_confirms_row_removed
preconditions: Player with squadNumber=15 exists in DB
App is running in-process via TestClient
expected: POST returns HTTP 201 confirming the unique constraint slot is free again
trace: R-PLAYER-021: row truly removed from DB; re-insert succeeds only if row is gone; STC state-transition from exists->deleted->recreated
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_delete_then_recreate_confirms_row_removed():
    del_resp = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/15')
    assert del_resp.status_code == 204
    payload = {
        'firstName': 'Test',
        'lastName': 'Player',
        'squadNumber': 15,
        'position': 'Goalkeeper'
    }
    post_resp = client.post('/players/', json=payload)
    assert post_resp.status_code == 201
    body = post_resp.json()
    assert body['squadNumber'] == 15
    assert body['firstName'] == 'Test'
    assert body['lastName'] == 'Player'

test_delete_then_recreate_confirms_row_removed()

preconditions: Players with squadNumber=8 and squadNumber=9 both exist in DB
App is running in-process via TestClient
expected: GET squadNumber=9 returns HTTP 200 with correct player data (Vikram Sharma)
trace: R-PLAYER-021: only the targeted row is removed; adjacent rows unaffected; EP + comparison-mutation catch
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_delete_does_not_affect_other_players():
    del_resp = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/8')
    assert del_resp.status_code == 204
    get_resp = client.get('/players/squadnumber/9')
    assert get_resp.status_code == 200
    body = get_resp.json()
    assert body['squadNumber'] == 9
    assert body['firstName'] == 'Vikram'
    assert body['lastName'] == 'Sharma'
    assert body['id'] == 'b24f74ac-bb2d-4e87-97ea-679b802116dd'
